SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id) AS new_engaged_users
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201231' AND '20210107' -- covers 7-day window ending 2021-01-07 (2020-12-31..2021-01-07 inclusive)
  AND EXISTS (
    -- had positive engagement_time_msec in the 7-day window
    SELECT 1
    FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
    WHERE ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec' AND SAFE_CAST(ep.value.int_value AS INT64) > 0
  )
  AND user_pseudo_id NOT IN (
    -- exclude users who had any positive engagement_time_msec in the 2-day window (2021-01-06..2021-01-07)
    SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
    WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210106' AND '20210107'
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep2
        WHERE ep2.key = 'engagement_time_msec' AND SAFE_CAST(ep2.value.int_value AS INT64) > 0
      )
  )

SELECT
  prod.productSKU AS product_sku,
  prod.v2ProductName AS product_name,
  SUM(prod.productQuantity) AS total_quantity,
  SUM(prod.productRevenue) AS total_revenue
FROM
  `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS prod
WHERE
  _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM UNNEST(hits) AS h2, UNNEST(h2.product) AS p2
    WHERE p2.v2ProductName = 'Youtube Men’s Vintage Henley'
      AND (fullVisitorId = fullVisitorId) -- correlates to same session row
  )
  AND prod.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
  AND prod.v2ProductName != 'Youtube Men’s Vintage Henley'
GROUP BY
  product_sku,
  product_name
ORDER BY
  total_quantity DESC,
  total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1
